articles.title: Sugar & Spice For Couples App Launches on iPhone
articles.description: NEW YORK, Sept. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sugar & Spice for Couples, an intimate couples game that originated as the driving force behind New York Times bestseller J.D. Barker's psychological thriller 'Behind a Closed Door' (published domestically by Hampton Creek Press), has launched on the Apple App Store. The app marks the first time the game that captivated readers of the international bestselling novel is available for real-world play-blurring the line between Barker's fiction and reality.

articles.title: How Ogawa is pioneering the modern wellness journey
articles.description: FOR years, massage chairs have been associated with rest and relaxation, but research suggests they offer broader wellness benefits. A joint study by Ogawa and Universiti Malaya found that Ogawa massage chairs improved sleep quality and blood circulation by up to 88 percent and 81 percent, respectively.
